candidates.change: Remove only ema20 > ema50; retain prior-close EMA20 reclaim, next-open fill, long side and 12-bar hold
candidates.reason: Test whether the hard trend gate excludes recoveries; prior deep/recovery-region profits warn against ever-stricter trend filters. This is a mechanism hypothesis, not measured support for removal.
candidates.risk: May add bearish rebounds; existing profitable signals remain eligible but ownership can change their fills.

parent_executable_spec.entry_rule: ema20 > ema50 and lag('close',1) <= lag('ema20',1) and close > ema20

candidates.change: Keep exact high-volatility impulse signals; delay entry by one 4h bar unconditionally; same 12 held bars after actual fill.
candidates.reason: Test whether immediate impulse execution loses edge to temporary price pressure. No confirmation filter or outcome-dependent entry selection.
candidates.risk: May miss persistent continuation or worsen entry price; delay reserves native ownership and can alter subsequent fills.

parent_executable_spec.entry_rule: abs(ret1) >= 1.5 * retstd20 and ret1 > 0 and ema20 > ema50

deduplication: Semantic grouping, no cosmetic indicator variants. EMA-order admission removal and source-signal entry latency are different actions; no Cartesian combination.
